body:
KanbanHandler only ever used plain log.Printf, never joined the S226 unified-logging rollout every other real IDUNA code path (auth/admin/HEIMDAL/Apples) already has. New EventLog field wired in main.go, reusing the shared emitAuthEvent helper. Three real emission points: iduna:kanban.card.create/.move/.complete. New TestKanban_EmitsUnifiedLogEvents, real userlog.NewFileEventLog-backed. go build/vet/test ./... clean, zero regressions.

⚓ ☃
title: Kanban card 3243242: real unified-log event emission for kanban card create/move/complete
